title: Implement scope and path enforcement

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python v1 scope and path enforcement assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: The exact current Python forest contains mature fail-closed path and scope controls in separate authorities: repository target resolution, deterministic repair-root ownership, and GUI patch scope. None is a PCSM source-link/rewrite admission package bound simultaneously to canonical source identity, current commit/tree, aggregate PCSM source-map CID, exact current file/node/span, and a closed deterministic decision. The declared-output authority for this dispatch permits only this receipt. The smallest authority-preserving delta is therefore a typed unavailable/non-promotion disposition; no competing scope authority or unreviewed source mutation is created.
scope.non_promotion_reason: Required general validation passes in the provider and sealed environments, but it exercises structured residual-output decoding, not current-forest source-link/rewrite scope enforcement. PCSM-051 and PCSM-052 record the still-absent source-map/linker prerequisites. No package-specific positive and negative vectors exist, so no completion or promotion is authorized.

evidence_legend.measured: Observed directly from the named current source forest or the authoritative sealed validation environment.
evidence_legend.estimated: A calculated approximation; it cannot establish scope/path behavior, current-tree identity, schema binding, or test success.
evidence_legend.simulated: A controlled provider-environment execution; it cannot replace sealed validation or authorize mutation or promotion.
evidence_legend.unavailable: A required identity, capability, or result absent from the authoritative environment; it is neither zero nor passing.

Generic fail-closed scope/path controls exist, but the focused search found no PCSM source scope/path contract, SourceMapResolver@1, SourceLinkReceipt@1, BoundedPythonLinker@1, SemanticSourceLinker, source_link_receipt, or source_map_resolver identifier.

pcsm_source_map.reason: No current-tree PCSM SourceMapResolver@1, SourceLinkReceipt@1, canonical aggregate source-map CID, or source-link/rewrite admission receipt exists. required_package_assessment.required_package: PCSM Python-v1 scope and path enforcement for current source-link/rewrite admission
required_package_assessment.required_contract: A versioned closed admission receipt binding canonical source identity (not an alias), base current commit/tree, aggregate source-map CID, exact current file CID, normalized repository-relative path, resolved node/SourceSpan, allowed semantic scope, and deterministic typed allow/reject reason before any source-link/rewrite operation.
required_bindings: explicit scope/path admission schema and version
canonical CodeIR or source identity CID rather than an alias
base current commit and tree identity
current aggregate source-map CID and exact current file CID
normalized repository-relative path and resolved node/SourceSpan after symlink-safe containment
declared allowed semantic scope and closed operation grammar
deterministic decision, canonical receipt identity, and typed rejection for undeclared, escaped, stale, missing, ambiguous, overlapping, generated, and unsupported targets

positive in-scope/current-source vectors and negative path-escape, parent traversal, absolute-path, symlink escape, undeclared-path, cross-root, stale-map, ambiguity, overlap, and generated-source vectors

source_search.method: rg -n -i --glob '*.py' --glob '*.json' --glob '*.md' 'PCSM.*(scope|path)|ScopePath(Enforcement|Gate)|SourceScope(Receipt|Gate)|SourcePath(Receipt|Gate)|SourceMapResolver|SourceLinkReceipt|BoundedPythonLinker|SemanticSourceLinker|source_link_receipt|source_map_resolver' over external/ipfs_accelerate/ipfs_accelerate_py/agent_supervisor and external/ipfs_accelerate/test/agent_supervisor, followed by focused inspection of repository_forest.py, target_resolver.py, root_ownership.py, patch_scope.py, and the required PCSM test module.
source_search.result: No PCSM source scope/path, source-map resolver, source-link receipt, or bounded Python linker identifier was found. The only matching scope gate is GuiPatchScopeGate@1, a GUI optimizer authority. The required test root contains one symlinked PCSM test module for residual structured decoding.
source_search.meaning: Existing controls remain in their established repository-resolution, deterministic-repair, or GUI domains and cannot be relabelled as PCSM current-source admission.

dependency_assessment.dependency: PCSM-052, with PCSM-051 as its source-map prerequisite
dependency_assessment.result: Those receipts record the source-map/linker capability gap. Their historical tree observations are not reused as current identity evidence here; this receipt independently rechecked the current source forest and confirmed that the prerequisites remain absent.

required_package_assessment.disposition: The requested behavior cannot truthfully be claimed implemented as a PCSM current-source admission gate, schema/version/CID bound, or covered by package-specific positive and negative tests. No source mutation, proof acceptance, validation acceptance, promotion, or task completion is authorized.

nearest_existing_equivalents.authority_boundary: Resolves a candidate under a RepositoryDescriptor and rejects containment failures after symlink resolution with RepositoryForestError(path_escape).
nearest_existing_equivalents.rejection_reason: It has no PCSM schema/version, canonical source identity CID, aggregate source-map CID, exact source node/span binding, declared semantic-scope admission, rewrite decision, or PCSM receipt.

nearest_existing_equivalents.authority_boundary: Binds named Git worktree roots to current head/tree and dirty-overlay fingerprints, canonicalizes write paths, and rejects escaping, ambiguous, cross-root, duplicate, and outside-prefix writes before returning a SHA-256-addressed ownership receipt.
nearest_existing_equivalents.rejection_reason: It is deterministic-repair ownership admission, not PCSM source-link/rewrite admission; it does not consume a PCSM source-map CID or resolve a canonical source identity to a current file/node/span.

nearest_existing_equivalents.authority_boundary: Fail-closed GUI proposal/diff/invalidation gate that rejects undeclared or unsafe paths and never treats a scope declaration as host authority.
nearest_existing_equivalents.rejection_reason: It is constrained to VerifiedGuiOptimizer proposals, GUI authority evidence, components, visual/state/test bounds, and GUI patch limits; it is not a general PCSM source-forest authority and must not be reused as one.

nearest_existing_equivalents.authority_boundary: Rejects parent traversal and, unless explicitly permitted, symlink scope hints before using repository containment resolution.
nearest_existing_equivalents.rejection_reason: It resolves a launch target/scope from resolver evidence; it neither creates an allowed PCSM source-edit scope nor binds source-map/linker identities or rewrite admission.

package_specific_tests.reason: No PCSM scope/path implementation, versioned source admission receipt, aggregate current-forest source-map CID, or package-specific positive/negative vector module exists in the bound source forest. Adjacent generic controls and residual structured-decoding tests are not substituted.

positive_coverage: all closed residual task families have grammars
a valid compact structured output decodes
a bounded typed patch sketch is valid
negative_coverage: parse failures, duplicate JSON fields, unknown fields, and model-created completion reject
untyped context and invalid ranking vectors reject

They do not bind a path to a current PCSM source-map CID, check source-file/node/span identity, distinguish cross-root/symlink/generated-source cases, or admit/reject a source-link/rewrite operation.

limitations: This task is receipt-only under exact declared-output authority; no task-owned implementation or test path may be changed by this dispatch.
The existing repository, repair, resolver, and GUI scope controls remain valid only in their established domains and are not promoted or relabelled as PCSM current-source admission.
Without a current aggregate PCSM source-map CID and linker receipt, path containment cannot establish source identity, semantic scope, or rewrite authorization.
The required suite passes in the sealed environment, but it provides no package-specific current-source scope/path positive or negative coverage.
No aliases are accepted as canonical identity and no M2/M3 mutation, generated-source mutation, or automatic source materialization is authorized.
The receipt has no immutable self-CID because minting a self-describing CID would change its bytes.
